problem.title: Find the Nearest Common Leaf of Two Nodes
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree and two distinct nodes, determine the leaf node that is reachable from both nodes with the minimum combined distance.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree. • The last line contains two node values.
problem.output: • Print the value of the required leaf.
